rules.name: AIPCC base image integration
rules.rationale: AIPCC is an RHOAI-specific integration with no OSAC equivalent.
rules.remediation: None; this rule is reported as NA for OSAC.

rules.name: Component documented in architecture diagrams
rules.rationale: Architecture documentation is a product-independent maturity requirement.
rules.remediation: Document the component in osac-project/enhancement-proposals or the canonical OSAC architecture documentation.

rules.name: Build from approved sources only
rules.rationale: Supply-chain provenance applies directly to OSAC deliverables.
rules.remediation: Update the product build configuration to use only approved source repositories and pinned inputs.

rules.name: FIPS compliance configured in build pipeline
rules.rationale: FIPS readiness is required for OSAC product deliverables.
rules.remediation: Add and document FIPS-mode build and test coverage for the deliverable.

rules.name: OSAC early-gate pipeline configured
rules.rationale: The RHOAI early-gate check maps to OSAC pre-merge and product-build validation.
rules.remediation: Configure the required OSAC pre-merge and product-build gate jobs for the repository.

rules.name: Installation and usage documentation exists
rules.rationale: Installation and usage documentation applies directly to OSAC deliverables.
rules.remediation: Add installation and usage documentation in the deliverable repository or osac-project/docs.

rules.name: OSAC module controller ships bootstrap manifests
rules.rationale: ODH bootstrap manifests map to OSAC operator-managed installation manifests.
rules.remediation: Add the module bootstrap manifests to osac-project/osac-operator or its declared module repository.

rules.name: OSAC module ships default configuration
rules.rationale: The RHOAI ConfigMap requirement maps to versioned OSAC module defaults.
rules.remediation: Provide version-controlled default configuration for the OSAC module.

rules.name: OSAC module API or CRD is defined
rules.rationale: ODH module CRDs map to the versioned API or CRD that osac-operator reconciles.
rules.remediation: Define and version the module API or CRD in osac-project/osac-operator.

rules.name: Module integrated into OSAC platform configuration
rules.rationale: The RHOAI DSC stanza maps to the OSAC platform configuration surface.
rules.remediation: Expose and reconcile the module through the supported OSAC platform configuration.

rules.name: Module included in the downstream OSAC product build
rules.rationale: RHOAI downstream operator registration maps to inclusion in the downstream OSAC operator build.
rules.remediation: Add the module to the downstream OSAC operator product build and catalog mapping.

rules.name: Module registered in OSAC operator
rules.rationale: ODH operator registration maps directly to osac-operator registration.
rules.remediation: Register the module controller and manifests in osac-project/osac-operator.

rules.name: Module API implements the OSAC status contract
rules.rationale: PlatformObject status maps to consistent OSAC API conditions and observed generation.
rules.remediation: Implement the documented OSAC status and condition contract for the module API.

rules.name: Multi-architecture builds configured
rules.rationale: Multi-architecture product builds apply directly to OSAC.
rules.remediation: Configure supported OSAC architectures in upstream CI and the downstream product build.

rules.name: OSAC support collection configured
rules.rationale: RHOAI must-gather maps to the supported OSAC diagnostic collection mechanism.
rules.remediation: Add the module resources, logs, and status to the OSAC support collection workflow.

rules.name: No unapproved external image references
rules.rationale: Disconnected and supply-chain requirements prohibit unapproved external images.
rules.remediation: Replace external image references with approved OSAC product images.

rules.name: Onboarded to OSAC upstream build system
rules.rationale: ODH build onboarding maps to OSAC upstream CI and build automation.
rules.remediation: Configure the repository's required OSAC CI and upstream build workflows.

rules.name: Onboarded to OSAC downstream product build
rules.rationale: RHOAI build onboarding maps to the downstream OSAC product build pipeline.
rules.remediation: Onboard the deliverable and its dependencies to the downstream OSAC product build.

rules.name: Prometheus monitoring configured
rules.rationale: Production observability is a product-independent GA requirement.
rules.remediation: Expose supported metrics and install the required Prometheus monitoring resources.

rules.name: OSAC APIs promoted to beta or stable
rules.rationale: RHOAI CRD promotion maps to OSAC API lifecycle maturity.
rules.remediation: Promote supported OSAC APIs from alpha to beta or stable versions.

rules.name: Module registered in OSAC QE inventory
rules.rationale: QE DSC registration maps to explicit OSAC module coverage in osac-test-infra.
rules.remediation: Register the module and its supported configurations in the OSAC QE inventory.

rules.name: OSAC QE test coverage exists
rules.rationale: RHOAI QE directory coverage maps to module coverage in osac-test-infra.
rules.remediation: Add module-level automated coverage to osac-project/osac-test-infra.

rules.name: OSAC Kubernetes APIs registered in product
rules.rationale: RHOAI API registration maps to an explicit OSAC API inventory backed by repository definitions.
rules.remediation: Add the module API to the OSAC product API inventory and operator manifests.

rules.name: OSAC product build definition exists
rules.rationale: OSAC uses a monorepo, so the upstream downstream-repository check maps to a component-scoped Tekton or product image build definition.
rules.remediation: Add the deliverable to the OSAC product build pipeline and map its build definition in the catalog.

rules.name: OSAC source mapping exists
rules.rationale: OSAC uses a monorepo, so the upstream midstream-repository check maps to an explicit repository and source-path mapping.
rules.remediation: Document the deliverable repository, source paths, and mapping evidence in the catalog.

rules.name: Onboarded into shift-left testing pipeline
rules.rationale: Pre-merge product testing applies directly to OSAC deliverables.
rules.remediation: Onboard the deliverable to the required OSAC shift-left test workflows.

rules.name: Snyk security findings triaged
rules.rationale: Security finding triage applies directly to OSAC components.
rules.remediation: Triage current Snyk findings and link accepted risks or remediation issues in OSAC Jira.

rules.name: Repository registered for Snyk scanning
rules.rationale: Supply-chain security scanning applies directly to OSAC repositories.
rules.remediation: Register the repository and applicable dependencies in the approved Snyk scanning configuration.

rules.name: Vulnerability tracking configured for OSAC product
rules.rationale: RHOAI product-definitions tracking maps to OSAC product vulnerability ownership and Jira workflow.
rules.remediation: Register the deliverable for product vulnerability tracking and document the owning OSAC component.
